description: This file is a shell script providing functions for upgrading Zyxel devices, including extracting root filesystem information, flashing firmware components, and performing the upgrade process with device-specific logic.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Extracts the root filesystem device from the kernel command line.
methods.return: The device string of the root filesystem

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Performs flashing of the kernel and root filesystem from an archive to specified device paths, and updates a dual flag if applicable.
methods.return: None, but may reboot the device on failure

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that determines device specifics and invokes the flashing process, based on device type and current boot state.
